title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Cloud (SaaS): Find out when your license expires (expiration date)
summary: Checking Business Central license expiration dates in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Users can find subscription renewal or expiration dates on the Billing > Your products page, with indicators for recurring billing or fixed expiration dates.
key_points: Navigate to Microsoft 365 admin center Billing section to view all subscriptions
Circle arrow icon indicates recurring billing; a date means the subscription expires on that date
Trial environments do not display expiration dates
Expired products show a Disabled status with an expiration message

quotes.text: Business Central is a full cloud solution now, included as an app in Microsoft 365.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes that Business Central is now a cloud-only solution requiring Microsoft 365 integration and Entra ID authentication.

quotes.text: In the Microsoft 365 admin center, go to the Billing -> Your products page.
quotes.why_it_matters: Provides the exact navigation path to find license expiration information.
